in_marathi.name: Devkansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's gift, divine grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devkansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devkansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘Deva’ (god) and ‘Kansh’ (grace or gift). It symbolizes the divine grace of gods bestowed upon a child. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with Lord Vishnu, who is believed to have granted Devkansh to his devotees.
